note: The one role table: default model and effort per role (spec #1, user story 17), and when a ticket needs the deep implementer. factory-frontier reads it to suggest each ticket's role; the merger role is kept for projects whose merges need judgement; the manager runs merges itself. Ticket #6 moves these defaults into the agent definitions' frontmatter; until then agents start as general-purpose with these values. Override per project with .factory/settings.json keys roles and deep_when.

merger.for: reserved: a merge that needs judgement (the manager runs ordinary merges itself, no agent)
